sentence: This project builds a framework that uses electronic health data and community translation to improve health outcomes.
This project designs a tool to learn how viral proteins interact with cell membranes and to help deliver drugs to targeted cells.
This project studies how electrical and structural changes in the heart lead to ventricular arrhythmia.
This project tests whether T cells specific for several tumor proteins can be made to prevent relapse after bone marrow transplant in leukemia.
This project combines basic science discoveries with clinical expertise and imaging to develop diagnostic approaches and treatments for prostate cancer.
This project looks for small molecules that block the making of Sonic hedgehog proteins and tests them on myeloma and colon cancer cells.
This project develops a whole-body optical imaging technique to measure biomarkers non-invasively during cancer immunotherapy.
This project studies how antimicrobial peptides act in biofilms, high-density colonies and nutrient-deprived bacterial cells, using microfluidic models, single-cell analysis and RNA-sequencing.
This project makes and closely analyzes vectors used in gene therapy for hemophilia A to help develop safer vectors.
This project studies how sustentacular cells in the olfactory epithelium respond to infection and how this contributes to olfactory dysfunction.
This project studies how adenovirus infects the cells on the surface of the eye and how host and pathogen proteins interact.
This project engineers improved genetically encoded voltage indicators and optical imaging systems to capture neuronal electrical activity.
This project studies how an epigenetic accessory protein controls gene expression, leukemia progression and response to treatment in acute myeloid leukemia.
This project builds tools and a controlled access platform to standardize, store, share and analyze data from approaches that can reduce animal testing.
This project searches plant genomes for genes that make cyclic peptides and produces libraries of plant peptides.
This project tests whether neuromodulation of inhibitory circuits controls how the developing auditory cortex changes with experience in a social setting.
This project builds computational models and methods to measure microbiomes accurately in the human body.
This project studies how enzymes called phosphagen kinases help cells respond to stress.
This project studies how a receptor kinase achieves signaling specificity in cell signaling pathways.
